CVP.Settings.Provider.Name: AI Provider
CVP.Settings.Provider.Hint: Which AI service Pseudo talks to. Bring your own key from that provider.
CVP.Settings.ApiKey.Name: API Key
CVP.Settings.ApiKey.Hint: Your private key for the selected provider. Stored world-side and only ever sent from a GM's client — players never receive it.
CVP.Settings.Model.Name: Model
CVP.Settings.Model.Hint: The model id to use (e.g. a fast, low-cost model from your provider). Left free-text on purpose so you can point it at the newest model without waiting for an update.
CVP.Settings.BaseUrl.Name: Base URL (optional)
CVP.Settings.BaseUrl.Hint: Override the API endpoint. Use this for OpenRouter or a self-hosted / proxy server. Leave blank to use the provider's default.
CVP.Settings.Summon.Label: Summon Pseudo
CVP.Settings.OpenSetup.Label: Pseudo Setup
CVP.Settings.KeepOnTop.Name: Keep assistant on top
CVP.Settings.KeepOnTop.Hint: Keep Pseudo's window above your other windows so it stays visible while you work. Turn off if you'd rather it sit in the normal window stack.
CVP.Settings.ExampleAutofill.Name: Right-arrow to use example
CVP.Settings.ExampleAutofill.Hint: While the message box is empty, press → (right arrow) to fill it with the example prompt currently shown. Turn off if you'd rather → just behave like a normal empty text box.
CVP.Setup.Title: Meet Pseudo
CVP.Setup.Intro: {moduleName} is your pseudodragon familiar — a small AI helper that reads your world to name things, answer lore and rules questions, and lend a hand while you run the game. To wake it up, it needs a free key from Google AI Studio. It takes about two minutes, and you only do this once.
CVP.Setup.Reassure.Free: It's free. Google AI Studio's free tier is generous — far more than a normal session ever uses.
CVP.Setup.Reassure.Private: It's yours. The key lives only in your browser. Your players never see it, and it's routed through you when they ask Pseudo something.
CVP.Setup.Reassure.NoCard: No credit card needed to get started.
CVP.Setup.Step1: Click the button below to open Google AI Studio in a new tab.
CVP.Setup.Step2: Sign in with any Google account.
CVP.Setup.Step3: Click “Create API key”, then copy the long string it gives you.
CVP.Setup.Step4: Come back here, paste it in, and press Test & Save.
CVP.Setup.ModelHint: Pre-filled with a sensible default. If the test says the model is unavailable or outdated, put the model name AI Studio lists here and test again.
CVP.Setup.NeedKey: Paste your key above first, then press Test & Save.
CVP.Setup.ErrorPrefix: That didn't work: {error} — double-check the key (and that it's enabled for the Gemini API) and try again.
CVP.Setup.Success: Your key checked out and is saved. Press Alt+A any time to summon Pseudo (you can rebind it under Configure Controls).
CVP.Setup.Dismiss: Skip for now — don't show this again
CVP.Keybindings.Summon.Name: Summon Pseudo
CVP.Keybindings.Summon.Hint: Open Pseudo's assistant window to ask about your world's journals, actors, monsters, tables, and cards.
CVP.Keybindings.Mic.Name: Toggle Pseudo's microphone
CVP.Keybindings.Mic.Hint: Start or stop voice dictation, same as clicking the mic button. Only works while Pseudo's window is already open.
CVP.Assistant.Title: Pseudo
CVP.Assistant.Empty: Summon complete. Ask Pseudo about anything in your world — or type /wizards to see everything it can walk you through step by step.
CVP.Assistant.Placeholder: Ask Pseudo… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
CVP.Assistant.NoSpeech: Voice input isn't available in this browser.
CVP.Assistant.NotConfigured: Pseudo has no API key yet. Open the module settings to add one.
CVP.Assistant.NoGM: No GM is available right now, so Pseudo can't answer. Ask again once your GM is online.
CVP.Portability.Title: Make Your Campaign Portable
CVP.Relay.GMNotConfigured: The GM hasn't set up Pseudo's API key yet.
CVP.Relay.Timeout: Pseudo didn't answer in time. Try again in a moment.
CVP.Errors.NoModel: No model is set. Open Pseudo's settings and enter a model id for your provider.
CVP.Errors.ProviderUnsupported: The "{provider}" provider isn't wired up yet — Gemini is the first supported one.
CVP.Errors.EmptyReply: The model returned an empty response.
CVP.Errors.RateLimited: Pseudo hit the AI rate limit. Wait a few seconds and try again.
CVP.Errors.NoFinalAnswer: Pseudo couldn't finish that — try rephrasing the question.
CVP.Omni.Title: Sharpen Pseudo's senses
CVP.Omni.Body: Pseudo searches your world through Spotlight Omnisearch. For the best results — so it can find monsters, items, and even rules by topic (like "the grappling rules") — it should index your compendiums, journal headings, and world documents. Enable the recommended Omnisearch settings now? (You can change them later in Omnisearch's settings.)
CVP.Omni.Done: Omnisearch tuned — Pseudo can now search your compendiums and rules.
CVP.Trouble.Title: Pseudo Troubleshooter
CVP.Trouble.Notes: A diagnostic snapshot of your setup — Foundry, Pseudo's config, dependency health, and active modules. Copy or export it when asking for help. It does not include your API key.
CVP.Trouble.DiagnosePrompt: Review my Foundry and Pseudo setup diagnostics and point out anything broken, inactive, misconfigured, or worth fixing.
